description:
Recent changes to visa and residence rules that GoThere has verified.

    Newest first. Each entry has the old and new value and the official source.

    Args:
        country: Optional ISO alpha-2 code or English name.
        since: Optional date; only changes on or after it are returned.
        limit: Maximum entries, 1 to 100. Default 20.

country.description: Optional ISO alpha-2 code or English country name. Omit for all countries.
country.title: Country

limit.description: Maximum entries to return, 1 to 100. Out of range values are clamped.
limit.title: Limit

since.description: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only changes on or after it are returned.
since.title: Since

name: get_rule_changes
title: Get recent visa rule changes
